profile: 30s stereo48kHz generated lossless FLAC; prepared approximately2s independent FLAC chunks
baseline: Fetch/decode complete source, consume every sample once through deterministic per-channel checksum, release context
candidate: Sequentially fetch/decode each prepared independent chunk, consume every sample once through same checksum, release chunk references and context
correctness_first: Exact per-channel Float32 hashes of each chunk against full continuous decode slices, total count equal, one-sample shifted oracle rejects
sampling: one correctness execution then one warmup pair and five alternating measured pairs, fresh AudioContext per operation; all same Chrome session and loopback origin
metrics: peak explicitly retained decoded PCM payload bytes, not browser process memory
threshold: accept prepared-consumer profile only if candidate median total wall <= 1.25 * baseline and retained PCM payload <= baseline/8; reject cold profile if candidate median plus measured preparation exceeds1.25*baseline
included_costs: candidate preparation separately charged for cold use
excluded_costs: opaque browser allocations and GC retention
